data.name: Nethra
data.gender_notes: Nethra is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Nethra is the goddess of eyes and vision. She is believed to protect and bless her devotees with good vision and insight. The name Nethra carries the meaning “Eye, Vision” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nethra usually hope their child will grow to embody eye, vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Opens the doors to knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Nethra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eye, Vision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nethra total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nethra highlights the importance of eyesight and clear vision in Indian culture. It reflects the significance of the sense of sight in Hinduism and stresses the importance of discernment, perception, and understanding. Additionally, it pays homage to the revered deity Nethra as a goddess of good vision, illustrating the deep connection between spirituality and physical health.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nethra holds immense spiritual significance as it is associated with Lord Shiva, one of the primary deities in Hinduism. In this context, Nethra signifies 'divine sight' or 'insight into spiritual truth.' It encourages individuals to look inward, to gain depth and clarity of understanding about themselves and their connection to the divine. Furthermore, it symbolizes the idea that perception is a powerful tool on the spiritual journey and can bring about enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nethra means 'eye' in Sanskrit. Symbolically, it represents the power of perception and insight, enlightening one's mind and guiding one's actions. Spiritually, it signifies the inner vision that leads us towards the path of truth and wisdom.
